Family Medicine Physicians' daily work centers on clinical care and prevention: seeing patients and taking medical histories, performing physical examinations, ordering and interpreting laboratory tests and imaging, making diagnoses and developing treatment plans, managing chronic and common acute conditions, providing immunization, screening, and healthy lifestyle guidance, referring patients to specialists when needed, and completing medical records, explaining risks and follow-up arrangements to patients. Some positions also involve teaching, research, and quality improvement.
